description: Makes an account — a card, a bank account, UPI, a wallet, cash — with what is known: its type (`tag`, the app's own words: "credit card", "bank account"), the account it is linked to (`linked_to`, a card to the bank account that pays it, one level), the person it belongs to (`member`, someone the memory holds), its `notes` (one detail per line, such as a card's printed name as "Card name: Platinum Reserve"; numbers are refused) and a `balance` with the day it was true. A name another account already wears is refused rather than doubled; update_account changes one that exists. Writes are schema-validated and provenance-stamped, and land in the app's Proposals screen where the owner keeps or undoes the whole batch. Card numbers, CVVs and credentials are refused by the validator, which names the row. `source` ("documents/hdfc-2026.pdf", "gmail:18c2…") records where a row came from in the diff.

balance.description: What the account held on balance_date.

balance_date.description: The day the balance was true. Left out beside a balance, the day of the write is used.

guide_key.description: The guide_key read_guide returned with the prompt or chapter this write follows.

linked_to.description: The account this one is linked to — a card to the bank account that pays it — by name or id. One level only.

member.description: The person the account belongs to, by name or id as the memory holds them.

name.description: The display name — "Visa 9292", the last four digits at most. Refused when another account already wears it.

notes.description: What is particular about the account, one detail per line, each "Label: value" — on a card, "Card name: Platinum Reserve", the product printed on it; its number is refused. Rewritten as the account now stands. Null or "" clears.

tag.description: The account type, in the app's own words — "credit card", "bank account", "UPI", "wallet", "cash".

name: add_account
title: Add an account
